scope.rationale: D176.4 adds the comprehensive JSON-shape test surface: direct recursive-writer boundaries in core (tests/nextorm.core.tests/JsonShapeWriterTests.cs), end-to-end nested/join/slot/terminal/cache regression coverage over SQLite (tests/nextorm.sqlite.tests/JsonStreamingTests.cs), and per-dialect SQL-lowering regression tests that assert the JSON nested-shape lowering emits the same explicit scalar columns as the ordinary flat projection for PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL and ClickHouse. No product source is changed unless a defect is exposed.
scope.boundary: Full affected project sweeps: C02 core, full SQLite project and each touched dialect project, after the last edit; the filtered JSON classes are re-run after every coherent edit.
